explanation: $~Yeh woh zubaanein hain jin mein aap ka mansooba likha gaya hai.
Aap likhne ke liye nayi zubaan shamil kar sakte hain, jo zubaan istemaal nahin ho rahi use hata sakte hain, ya poore mansooba ka nayi zubaan mein tarjuma kar sakte hain.

Yeh dekhne ka acha tareeqa hai ke aap ka program apni qeemat *kaise* nikalta hai, aur yeh samajhne ka bhi ke @wordplay programs kaise chalte hain, khaas kar jab aap ko woh nateeja na mile jo aap chahte hain.
tour.modes: $~/Mode switcher/ chunta hai ke aap ka program kaise chale. ✏️ *edit* haalat mein program jahan hai wahin ruk jata hai aur aap usay badal sakte hain — aap ki tabdeeliyan dobara chal kar wahan un ka asar dikhati hain. ⏸️ *debug* haalat mein code sirf parhne ke liye hota hai, aur aap ke program ke har hisse ki *maujooda qeemat* editor mein aur palette mein us ke saath nazar aati hai. ▶️ *play* haalat mein aap ka program jahan hai wahin se seedha chalta hai, aur dakhil hone wali cheezon par fauran jawab deta hai. Switcher ke saath /perform/ button hai — ek play tikon jis ke ird-gird poori screen ke konay hain — jo shuru se pesh-kash shuru karta hai aur stage se poori screen bhar deta hai, aur ↻ kisi bhi haalat mein program ko dobara shuru karta hai.
tour.annotations: $~/Annotations/ window woh jagah hai jahan har qadam ki wazahat nazar aati hai. Jab aap apne program mein qadam ba qadam chalte hain, to yahan parhein ke abhi kya hua.
tour.editor: $~/Editor/ aap ka code dikhata hai. Qadam ba qadam chalate waqt, aap ke program ke har hisse ki *qeemat* us hisse ke baad nazar aati hai jab woh chal chuka ho, taa-ke aap dekh saken ke program chalte hue qeematein kaise banti hain.
tour.history: $~/History/ woh har *input* dikhati hai jo aap ke program ko mila hai, jaise kunjiyan, waqt ki tik, aur pointer ke waqiaat. Yeh *ghaseet* sakti hai, is liye aap ghaseet kar program ki tareekh ke kisi bhi lamhe par wapas ja sakte hain. Agar aap in inputs ko dekhne ke bajaye *sunna* chahte hain, to settings mein /dobara chalne ke ishaare/ chalu karein, aur @wordplay har input ke liye ek chhoti si awaaz bajayega, aur har qism ke input ki awaaz alag hogi.
tour.stepControls: $~/Step controls/ aap ko program ki jaanch mein bilkul theek tarah chalne dete hain. Aap *aaghaz* ya *anjaam* par ja sakte hain, ek ek qadam *aage* ya *peechhe* ja sakte hain, *ek input* ke hisaab se kood sakte hain, kisi function se *bahar* nikal sakte hain, ya code ke *chuney hue* hisse par ja sakte hain.

Lekin is ke liye kuch usool maanne parte hain. Aap wada karte hain ke aap ka mansooba yeh nahin karta:

pii.explanation:
$~Zaati pehchaan wali maloomaat (PII) sab ke saamne baantne se banane walon ko khatra ho sakta hai, is liye hum mumkin PII ka pata lagate hain aur banane walon ko khabardar karte hain ke woh ya to hassas maloomaat hata dein ya use ghair hassas nishan zad kar dein.

Neeche is mansooba mein mumkin PII ki fehrist hai jo aap ne ghair hassas nishan zad ki hai. Aap is ke saath wale button par click kar ke use dobara hassas bana sakte hain, lekin aisa karne par aap ka mansooba online mehfooz nahin hoga.

preview.explanation: $~Yeh chhota sa nishan hai jo fehriston aur numaish gahon mein aap ke mansooba ko dikhata hai. Auto aap ke mansooba ke dikhaye gaye matn ke mutabiq ek chun leta hai; Custom se aap ek harf ya emoji khud muntakhib kar sakte hain.

remix.explanation: $~/Remix/ kisi mansooba ki woh copy hai jise kisi ne badal kar apna bana liya ho. Hum yaad rakhte hain ke remix kahan se aaya, taake asal banane wale ko ab bhi shabaash mile.

research.explanation:
$~Kabhi kabhi hum Wordplay ke baare mein likhte aur baat karte hain — tehqeeqi maqalon mein, taqreeron mein, aur asatiza aur gharwalon ko dikhaye jane wale materials mein. Agar aap ise on karein, to hum is mansooba ko misaal ke taur par dikha sakte hain, aap ke naam, username, ya aisi kisi cheez ke baghair jo bataye ke account aap ka hai.

Aap ise kisi bhi waqt band kar sakte hain. Band karne ka matlab hai ke hum aap ka mansooba kisi nayi cheez mein istemaal karna band kar denge, lekin jo cheez pehle hi shaya ya pesh ho chuki ho use wapas nahin liya ja sakta.

Har zubaan apni fehrist khud likhti hai, is liye apni zubaan ki zaroorat ke mutabiq jitne chahein shamil karein.
